objective: Census of not-all-equal relations (exhaustive n <= 6, sampled n = 7): is the map from a relation to its pairwise bond-distance table injective, unsigned, signed, and with the full bond set? Report collisions and the smallest example.
status: Supported 2026-11-17 (referee pending): census of every NAE base at n = 4, 5, 6 and 258,384 sampled at n = 7: pairwise bond distance fails at n = 4 (12 tables for 16 relations), signed ties and bond sets fail at n = 5, bonds with their excluded joint states determine every relation tested; 4 of 5 predictions held (D4 failed), control clean.
title: Do bond-distance tables determine not-all-equal relations
